messages:
alice: heads-up — incident-bot paged for edge-5xx-spike at 2026-03-10T09:40:00Z. root ts 1769010000. short summary: brief surge of 5xx from edge-proxy during a canary deploy window (~6m). majority appear to be probes and CDN retries, so noisy but small customer impact. tagging for alert tuning follow-up.

incident-bot: Page triggered: edge-5xx-spike (count > 150 in 1m) — routed to @oncall-sre. Auto-escalation pending.

sam: looked through the raw logs. ~80% of the 5xx are 502s hitting /healthz and ~25 events are from CDN retry header x-cdn-retry: true. only a handful of unique user errors. noise from probe bursts during the deploy.

maria: yep. we should exclude obvious probe paths and add header-aware filters. i propose adding an indexed boolean tag transient_retry when header present, then use it in the rule rather than string NOTs. also exclude /healthz and /hc.

kai: current rule (simplified) is:
```
index=prod source=edge-proxy status>=500 | stats count by status,path
```
We should tighten it like:
```
index=prod source=edge-proxy status>=500 NOT path="/hc" NOT path="/healthz" NOT transient_retry=true | stats count as errors by status,path | where errors > 20
```
Add extra condition: alert only if distinct(client_ip) > 25 OR dc_count > 2 in 5m. That should cut single-source flares.

alice: good. one more pattern: we keep seeing kv_cache flush OOM logs during mem-pressure cycles. message contains something like "kv_cache::flush OOM instance=abc-1234" with different instance ids. we want a regex signature to avoid paging SRE (route to eng-runtime ticket instead).

sam: regex idea: `/kv_cache::flush\s+OOM(?:.*?instance=[A-Za-z0-9\-]+)?/i` — create a signature that marks severity=info and files a ticket to eng-runtime.

maria: for dashboards, can we add a per-cluster 5xx heatmap and a top-paths widget with an "exclude probes" toggle? that will make triage faster. add a small panel that shows "unique client_ips" for the spike too.

kai: i've added a short playbook blurb under "Alert tuning -> log-based" with the new rule rationale and example queries. PR pending: https://git.redwood/infra/alerting/pull/318

alice: action list: @sam push rule + parser change to add transient_retry tag (ETA 2h), @maria add dashboard panels + runbook snippet (ETA EOD), @kai create eng-runtime ticket for kv_cache OOM (route: ENG-RUNTIME-4567), @oncall-sre monitor next two deploy windows.

oncall-sre: acknowledged. i'll shadow the windows and confirm whether noise drops. will note any customer-facing errors.

sam: implemented parser change in staging and updated the alert rule:
```
index=prod source=edge-proxy status>=500 NOT path="/hc" NOT path="/healthz" NOT transient_retry=true | stats count as errors by status,path | where errors > 20
```
staging run: no noisy spikes for 30m. will promote after 30m observation.

maria: also adding parser rule to set transient_retry=true when header `x-cdn-retry:true` or similar seen — that will be indexed so other downstream alerts can use it.

incident-bot: Follow-up: rule updated in staging by sam at 2026-03-10T11:10:00Z. Promotion scheduled after observation window.

oncall-sre: 30m passed. no repeat noisy pages during the deployment windows. marking as "monitoring -> tuned" and leaving thread open for 24h.

alice: thanks. i'll draft a short post-incident note in #incidents summarizing: exact query added, parser snippet, regex for kv_cache OOM, dashboard screenshots, and link to playbook PR. tagging @support-leads so CS/PMs have visibility.

sam: promoted to prod at 2026-03-10T11:45:00Z. monitoring for 24h.

maria: note for later: if we still see repeated spikes aligned with deploys, consider deploying a temporary snooze flag during deploys rather than lowering sensitivity globally. added to backlog INFRA-2031.

kai: queued follow-up tasks into infra-sprint, including a unit test for the parser tag extraction.

alice: closing loop — last_message_ts 1769011320. will update incident tracker and close when 24h passes. anyone else?
